questions.question: Explain the classification of buildings based on occupancy and structural form as per the Nepal National Building Code (NBC), and discuss the general requirements for structural safety.
What do you understand by orientation of a building? Explain the primary climatic and environmental factors to be considered for proper building orientation in different climatic zones of Nepal.
Explain the functional requirements of ventilation in buildings. Compare natural ventilation systems with mechanical ventilation systems, and describe the essentials of air-conditioning (HVAC).
Describe thermal insulation and acoustic design in buildings. What are the common acoustical defects in auditoriums and lecture halls, and explain methods of noise control and sound insulation.
Explain fire protection and safety requirements in buildings. Describe fire-resisting construction, fire escape routes, fire-stop materials, and active fire fighting provisions.

Under what soil and site conditions are strap, combined, and raft footings preferred? Classify deep foundations (pile, pier, and well foundations) and describe common techniques for improving bearing capacity of weak soils.
What is damp proofing? Explain positive and negative side waterproofing and describe the causes, effects, and methods of damp prevention (DPC) in foundation basements and superstructure walls.
Define cavity wall and draw a neat cross-sectional sketch. Explain how cavity walls provide thermal insulation, damp resistance, and sound proofing in building envelopes.
Explain English bond and Flemish bond in brick masonry with neat elevations and plans of alternate courses for 1-brick and 1.5-brick thick walls. Differentiate between arches and lintels.
Define the various technical elements of a pitched roof with a neat sketch (ridge, hip, valley, purlin, common rafter, eaves, and wall plate). Compare King Post and Queen Post timber roof trusses.

Classify stairs: Doglegged, Open-well, Spiral, and Bifurcated stairs, stating their merits and demerits. Design a dog-legged/straight flight staircase for a residential building with a floor-to-floor height of 3 m, showing calculations for risers, treads, and landing dimensions.

Explain the size, location, and functional requirements of doors and windows in buildings. Describe sliding doors, revolving doors, collapsible steel gates, and compare dormer windows with gable windows.
Describe the construction procedure, components, and performance of different types of floor finishes: Cement concrete flooring, Terrazzo flooring, Mosaic tile flooring, and Mud flooring.

Explain internal building drainage and plumbing systems in multi-story residential buildings. Differentiate between one-pipe and two-pipe plumbing systems, and explain the working of septic tanks and soak pits.

Describe temporary supporting structures: compare Scaffolding (bricklayer's and mason's), Shoring (raking, flying, and dead/needle shores), and Underpinning with neat sketches and application scenarios.

What are the essential requirements of good formwork for RCC construction? Explain the correct sequence of formwork stripping (striking) and factors affecting stripping duration. Describe formwork for RCC walls and columns.

Explain the primary causes of structural and non-structural cracks in buildings. Describe methods of crack repair, retrofitting techniques, and configuration-related factors for seismic safety of existing buildings.

Explain the concept, principles, and rating systems (such as GRIHA and LEED) for Green and Sustainable Buildings. Explain components of rooftop rainwater harvesting systems and passive solar design concepts for heating and cooling.
